ARCHITECTURE (from static source scan):
- Register VM, NOT factory-table VM. No c3/HA-style spans exist (span
  harvest returns 0 for QS/D/S/O_): payload lives as bytecode interpreted
  by an opcode loop, so v6 static techniques do not transfer. Full static
  lift = devirtualize the interpreter (Luraph-lifter scale, out of scope).
- QS = register file/stack (65 indexed writes: QS[V-1]=args init,
  QS[i](...) calls, (QS)[i]=T stores). S = second stack. I = upvalue table
  (resolved in a loop: g[3]=g[1][g[2]]). D = constants. T = temps.
- Dispatcher: GN=Lb(...) opcode fetch + ranged if-chains (19-23, 23-32,
  26-31...); M/H secondary dispatchers; Uy/fO/E/M operand decoders;
  nU() arg packing. Opaque-predicate style: (k+n)%2, vS*vS%7/%11.
- getfenv x2 adjacent: Qt=getfenv captured to Qt/e (env table reads only;
  no pairs() anywhere in source -> no env enumeration).
